subject: food-technology
title: Macronutrients and Micronutrients
welcome_lead: From carbohydrate to selenium — what the body needs in big and small amounts.
meta_desc: A-Level Food Tech: macronutrients and micronutrients defined.

concepts.def: Carbohydrate, protein, fat — needed in large amounts.
Vitamin or mineral — needed in small amounts.
Amino acid the body cannot synthesise (9 in adults).
Omega-3 and omega-6 — must come from diet.
A, D, E, K — stored in body fat.
B-complex and C — excreted in urine, daily intake needed.

walkthroughs.body_html: Macronutrients: carbohydrates (~4 kcal/g), protein (4 kcal/g), fat (9 kcal/g). Each plays structural, energy and signalling roles.
13 essential vitamins: A, C, D, E, K, and B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B9, B12. Key minerals include calcium, iron, zinc, iodine, selenium, magnesium, potassium, sodium.
Essential means the body cannot make it — must come from diet. Adults need 9 essential amino acids (children also histidine in higher amounts), 2 essential fatty acids (α-linolenic, linoleic).
